## 3. HX-140 Centrifugal Pump

The HX-140 is recommended for pulp and paper stock transfer applications. It uses a closed impeller and a mechanical shaft seal as standard.

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Maximum flow rate | 815 L/min |
| Maximum head | 30 m |
| Motor power | 19.9 kW |
| Impeller diameter | 334 mm |
| Dry weight | 372 kg |
| Inlet connection | DN100 |
| Maximum fluid temperature | 105 degC |
| Motor enclosure rating | IP65 |
